title: Live Free Jet Ski - Rentals
specs: Two like-new Sea-Doo jet skis: Wake 155 (family-friendly) and GTR 230 (performance)
Delivered fully fueled to your New Hampshire lake's public launch ramp
No hourly metering; full seven-day rental period
USCG-approved life jackets included for every rider
Operator must be 16 or older with a New Hampshire Safe Boater Education Certificate
Primary renter must be 21 or older with government-issued photo ID verified at delivery
Operators aged 16–17 must be accompanied by a supervising adult 21 or older at all times
Passengers of any age allowed with a qualified operator
Must present boating education certificate at delivery
includes: Delivery and pickup anywhere in New Hampshire
USCG-approved life jackets for every rider
Pre-delivery safety walkthrough covering controls, kill switch, life jackets, and local water rules
Full seven-day rental period with no hourly metering
blurb: Live Free Jet Ski rents two like-new Sea-Doos by the week, delivered fully-fueled to New Hampshire lakes. Rentals run Saturday to Saturday with delivery and pickup at the public launch ramp. Life jackets are provided for every rider and a safety walkthrough is included at delivery.
extraNote: 15% non-refundable reservation deposit charged at checkout via Stripe · $500 refundable security deposit held on card at delivery, released within 5 business days after satisfactory return · Balance due at delivery · Late returns billed at $60 per hour after 10:00 AM Saturday · Fuel returned short charged at market rate plus $5 per gallon surcharge · Cancellation more than 5 days before rental: lose deposit but balance refunded; inside 5 days full rental fee forfeited · Rental season runs May through October · Public launch ramp at the lake where the rental is delivered · May through October
